svg.text: Tube 4,850 long; overall 5,000 with the point; 33 kg, two to lift

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Point: four 4 mm plate triangles welded to a cone, 150 long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap disc 76 dia x 6 welded on the top; it takes every blow

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Five 12.5 cross holes at 200 pitch, the top one 712 below the cap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the holes square through both walls on one line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a paint ring 3,500 above the point: drive to this ring at the bed

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint after drilling; leave the bore open to drain

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: straight within 10 over the length; the pin slides through every hole
